title: Naulon configuration
description: Input configuration for the Naulon data-envelope model. Every implementation validates against this file.

profile.description: Behavioural preset from constants.yaml. Overridden by `device` and `fields`.

device.description: Overrides on the profile's device parameters.

fix_rate_hz.description: GNSS acquisition rate. Distinct from the output rate: a device may emit faster than it acquires, repeating the last fix.

output_rate_hz.description: Rate at which records are produced into the send buffer.

send_period_s.description: How often the buffer is flushed to the network. The single most expensive parameter in the model.

dedup_repeated_fix.description: If false, position fields are carried at the output rate even when the fix has not changed. This is the redundancy factor.

repeat_state_each_record.description: If true, vehicle-state fields are carried in every record instead of when they change.

compression_ratio.description: Payload compression factor (delta, varint). 1.0 means none.

session_policy.description: reconnect_per_send pays a handshake and a billing floor for every transmission.

emit_when_parked.description: Whether the full stream continues while the vehicle is stationary with the engine off.

fields.description: Per-field enable/disable, overriding the defaults in constants.yaml. Keys are field ids.

duty.description: How much the vehicle actually runs. Parked hours are not free.

tariff.description: Optional and entirely user-supplied. Naulon does not ship prices: M2M tariffs are contractual and not public.

billing_granularity_bytes.description: Per-session rounding unit. Rounding penalises frequent small transmissions.
